"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))

import json
import re

cd /repo && cat > /tmp/test_filter.py <<'EOF'
from app.api.handlers import handle_filter_users

def status(r): return r[0]
def users(r): return r[1]["users"]
def ids(r): return [u["id"] for u in users(r)]

# no filters -> all, ordered
print("all:", handle_filter_users({}))
assert status(handle_filter_users({})) == 200
assert ids(handle_filter_users({})) == [1, 2, 3]

# name_contains
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"name_contains": "ada"})) == [1]
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"name_contains": "ADA"})) == [1]
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"name_contains": "hopper"})) == [3]
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"name_contains": "  ada  "})) == [1]
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"name_contains": "a"})) == [1, 2, 3]

# % and _ literal
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"name_contains": "%"})) == []
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"name_contains": "_"})) == []

# name invalid
for bad in ["", "   ", "a"*31, 5, None, ["ada"]]:
    r = handle_filter_users({"name_contains": bad})
    assert r == (400, {"error": "invalid filter"}), (bad, r)
# exactly 30 ok
assert status(handle_filter_users({"name_contains": "a"*30})) == 200

# email_domain
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"email_domain": "example.com"})) == [1, 2, 3]
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"email_domain": "EXAMPLE.COM"})) == [1, 2, 3]
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"email_domain": "com"})) == []
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"email_domain": "amp.com"})) == []
for bad in ["ada@example.com", "ex ample.com", "", 3, None, "exa_mple.com", "ex%ample.com"]:
    r = handle_filter_users({"email_domain": bad})
    assert r == (400, {"error": "invalid filter"}), (bad, r)

# ids
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"min_id": "2"})) == [2, 3]
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"max_id": "2"})) == [1, 2]
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"min_id": "3", "max_id": "1"})) == []
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"min_id": "1", "max_id": "3"})) == [1, 2, 3]
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"min_id": "01"})) == [1, 2, 3]
for key in ("min_id", "max_id"):
    for bad in ["", "1a", "1.5", "-1", " 1", 2, None, "١٢"]:
        r = handle_filter_users({key: bad})
        assert r == (400, {"error": "invalid filter"}), (key, bad, r)

# other keys ignored
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"foo": "bar"})) == [1, 2, 3]
assert ids(handle_filter_users({"foo": "bar", "name_contains": "ada"})) == [1]

# combined
r = handle_filter_users({"name_contains": "a", "email_domain": "example.com", "min_id": "2"})
assert ids(r) == [2, 3], r

# all invalid combos still 400
assert handle_filter_users({"name_contains": "ada", "max_id": "x"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid filter"})

print("ALL TESTS PASSED")
